summary: Theil–Sen slope = 1.408 U/mL per degree C
Finite original pairwise slopes = 780; bootstrap replicates = 999

report: The robust slope was 1.408 U/mL per degree C, with a 95% percentile pairs-bootstrap interval of 1.184 to 1.618 (999 replicates). This estimates a linear location trend resistant to extreme responses; its interval is approximate and is not an exact slope test.
